spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Alax casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Alax makes two Fire Strike attacks.

action.name: Fire Strike
entries: {@atk ms,rs} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) fire damage.

action.name: Breath Weapon (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Alax exhales a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 ({@damage 4d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
